messages.subject: matrixInput with character variable
parts:
I am trying to use matrixInput to let the user create a dataset with 3 variables.  The first variable is a character variable, and the other 2 are numeric.  None of the examples I have looked at allow characters to be input; they all require numbers.  Is there any way to allow the user to input a character?

Thanks,
